pick.title: Centene sues the CMS over 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings
pick.headline: Centene Sues Government Over Report Card, Remains Committed to Quality Measurement in Principle
pick.take: Medicare Advantage star ratings are tied to bonus payments, so the stakes of a quality grade are admittedly high. Centene is now taking its 2027 score to court. Every insurer supports accountability right up until the grade arrives. Somewhere, a patient waits on hold for a prior authorization.
